question.question: Describe Vagabond setup other than hidden ruin items: pawn, quests, relationships and marked starting items.

expected.expected_answer: Choose character, pawn any forest; shuffle quests and display three; relationships Indifferent for each other faction. Take S-marked listed character items, tea/coins/bags face up on matching tracks, others Satchel; unused S items box.

source_passages.quotation: **Vagabond setup (9.3):** Choose Thief, Tinker or Ranger; place pawn in any forest. Shuffle quests and display three face up. Hide one each of the **R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword** beneath the four ruins: assemble and shuffle the four stacks and return each to an empty R slot so identities are hidden. Take S-marked starting items listed on character: tea, coins and bags go face up on matching tracks, other items face up in Satchel; return unused S items to box. Place each other faction's relationship marker at Indifferent.

answer.ruling: Choose Thief, Tinker or Ranger and place the Vagabond pawn in any forest. Shuffle the quests and display three face up.

Take the S-marked starting items listed for the chosen character. Put tea, coins and bags face up on their matching tracks, and put other starting items face up in Satchel. Return unused S-marked items to the box.
Place each other faction's relationship marker at Indifferent.
